papers.headline: LYRA: The formation and growth of nuclear star clusters in dwarf galaxies
papers.summary: Nuclear star clusters (NSCs) are dense massive star clusters ubiquitous in galactic centres across various mass regimes, present in up to ∼30 per cent of dwarf galaxies with M_star<10⁷ M☉.
papers.title: LYRA: The formation and growth of nuclear star clusters in dwarf galaxies

papers.headline: Atmospheric dynamics and variability of periodically irradiated tidally locked planets
papers.summary: Time-variable stellar heating may create new climate states, such as permanently hot or cold hemispheres, on asynchronous planets.
papers.title: Atmospheric dynamics and variability of periodically irradiated tidally locked planets

papers.headline: Gravitational-wave dark sirens as astrophysical probes: inferring galaxy-merger relations and identifying individual hosts
papers.summary: Gravitational-wave (GW) ``dark siren'' techniques, namely the statistical association of GW events with a galaxy catalog, have so far been used as a cosmological tool.
papers.title: Gravitational-wave dark sirens as astrophysical probes: inferring galaxy-merger relations and identifying individual hosts
